_comment: Ported from the sibling credit-limit-recommendation-system's config/policy.json (version 2026.08-mvp1), adapted to CES's own Product Tier values and column names. These are policy/business decisions, not measurements - a human can change any of these without retraining a model.
loss_given_difficulty_fallback_note: Used only when customer_view's own measured per-customer lgd is unavailable for an account - a deliberate improvement over a blind port of CLRS's flat constant: never fabricate when a measured value exists.
undrawn_exposure_conversion_factor_note: A FOURTH, independently-documented credit-conversion-factor value in this repo, not to be confused with the 0% risk-based CCF (12 CFR 217.33), the 5%/10% LCR outflow rate (engine/config/liquidity_policy.json), or the 10% SLR CCF (engine/config/leverage_capital_policy.*.json). This one is CLRS's own EAD proxy assumption for an expected-loss money figure, ported as-is.
